episodes.title: Sheesha
episodes.beat: Papa ke phone par baat hoti hai aur wo bolta hai - sheesha pehli raat khol mat. Usi raat narrator ghante 2:30 pe hall ke sheeshe ka dhakka hatata hai.
episodes.caption_dev: पापा ने कहा था — पहली रात शीशा मत खोलना।
episodes.cliffhanger: Sheeshe mein kamra khali hai. Uske peechhe koi nahi hai.
episodes.clue_planted: rule came from papa, not nana

episodes.beat: Kitchen ki ghadi 2:30 pe ruki hai. Maa kehti hai nana ne us raat set ki thi jab wo the. Raat ko ghadi apni jagah chalti hai - pichhe ki taraf.
episodes.caption_dev: घड़ी आज भी 2:30 पर अटकी है।
episodes.cliffhanger: Ghadi peechhe ki taraf chalti hai - ek minute bhi nahi, aadha.
episodes.clue_planted: clock stuck on the night Nana died

episodes.title: Pehli Nazar
episodes.beat: Pehli baar jaanboojh kar sheeshe mein dekhta hai. Reflection theek hai, bas kapda galat hai - ek kurta jo uske paas kabhi tha hi nahi.
episodes.caption_dev: आईने में कुर्ता है, मेरा नहीं।
episodes.cliffhanger: Kurta nana ka tha. Almirah me usi din pehna hua milta hai.
episodes.clue_planted: copy wears Nana's kurta

episodes.title: Kurta
episodes.beat: Kurta jhaag se lauta hai aur abhi bhi garam hai. Nana chhah saal pehle mare the.
episodes.caption_dev: कुर्ता अभी भी गरम है।
episodes.cliffhanger: Kurte ki jeb me ek chitthi hai, apni hi likhaawat me.
episodes.clue_planted: the copy is wearing the dead man's clothes

episodes.title: Teen Chehre
episodes.beat: Sheeshe mein teen chehre hain - woh, maa, aur beech mein ek aur. Beech wala uska hai, par thoda bada.
episodes.caption_dev: बीच में एक और चेहरा है।
episodes.cliffhanger: Woh chehra ek jyada umar ka hai.
episodes.clue_planted: the copy is older, not younger

episodes.title: Mogra
episodes.beat: Raat 2:30 ke baad poore ghar me mogra ki khushboo. Maa kehti hai har saal isi din mogra kaatni padti hai, aur raat me nahi.
episodes.caption_dev: रात में मोगरे की खुशबू।
episodes.cliffhanger: Savera courtyard me phool rakhe hain - geele abhi abhi kaate hue.
episodes.clue_planted: something cuts the flowers at night

episodes.title: Papa Ka Phone
episodes.beat: Papa Gulf se late call karte hain. Wo kehte hain nana ne ek baar unhe bhi mana kiya tha - aur wo poochte hain ki narrator ne aaj sheeshe mein dekha ya nahi.
episodes.caption_dev: पापा ने पूछा — तुमने आज शीशा देखा?
episodes.cliffhanger: Aaj raat 2 baje sheesha abhi band tha.
episodes.clue_planted: Papa was warned by Nana too

episodes.title: Cassi
episodes.beat: Nana ki almirah me ek cassette milti hai. Cassette par narrator ki apni awaaz hai - aur wo bol rahi hai aaj ki raat ka naam.
episodes.caption_dev: कैसेट में मेरी अपनी आवाज़ है।
episodes.cliffhanger: Cassette aaj ki raat ka number bol rahi hai. Aaj sirf aathvi raat hai.
episodes.clue_planted: the copy speaks three days ahead

episodes.title: Andhera
episodes.beat: Raat 2:30 par bijli chali jaati hai. Torch me neeche se teen knocks aate hain - courtyard se. Chautri kabhi nahi.
episodes.caption_dev: अंधेरे में तीन knocks। चौथी कभी नहीं।
episodes.cliffhanger: Andhere me sheeshe me sirf reflection dikhta hai. Kamre me roshni nahi hai.
episodes.clue_planted: the mirror needs no light

episodes.title: Pehla Kharchata
episodes.beat: Neeche se count karne ki himmat hoti hai: usne jo cheezein copy kehti hain, usse ek din pehle chhin li gayi hain.
episodes.caption_dev: आईने में वो एक दिन पुराना है।
episodes.cliffhanger: Do din pehle ka. Har raat ek din.
episodes.clue_planted: one detail is stolen every night

episodes.title: Baap Ka Chehra
episodes.beat: Copy ab narrator ki shakal nahi, papa ki shakal ban gayi hai - wahi chasma. Narrator ka apna chehra kahin gaya.
episodes.caption_dev: आईने में पापा का चेहरा है।
episodes.cliffhanger: Papa ke chasme almirah me rakhe the, khud ke paas.
episodes.clue_planted: the copy borrows Papa's face

episodes.title: Kuan
episodes.beat: Kitchen ke peechhe sukha kuan hai, saalon se bhar hua. Aaj paani me kuch dikh raha hai jo upar nahi hai.
episodes.caption_dev: सूखे कुएँ में पानी आज कैसे?
episodes.cliffhanger: Kuan me dikhne wala kamra hall ka hai - aur sheeshe me koi khada hai.
episodes.clue_planted: the well shows the mirror's room

episodes.title: Nana Ka Khat
episodes.beat: Almirah ke pichhe panpe ki parat me nana ka khat milta hai. Aadha paper kuta hua hai. Likha hai - sheeshe me sirf ek baar dekhna, aur aakhri.
episodes.caption_dev: नाना ने लिखा — सिर्फ एक बार।
episodes.cliffhanger: Khat ke aakhri shabd padhne se pehle sheeshe mein ek aadmi khada milta hai.
episodes.clue_planted: one deliberate look can be reversed

episodes.title: Doodhi Raat
episodes.beat: Raat adhoori hai - ghadi 1:15 pe hi 2:30 ho jaati hai. Story ke hisaab se aaj raat kuch khatam nahi hoti.
episodes.caption_dev: आज रात आधी रात में पूरी हो गई।
episodes.cliffhanger: Sunehre jo chhoti thi, ab poore kamre me pheli hai.
episodes.clue_planted: the clock now runs early

episodes.title: Jo Bikhar Gaya
episodes.beat: Sheesha ek pal ke liye phoot-ta hai aur usme kai chehre ek saath dikhte hain. Wo sab kisi aur ke hain.
episodes.caption_dev: आईने में बहुत सारे चेहरे थे।
episodes.cliffhanger: Ek chehra maa ka tha. Aaj wali umra ka.
episodes.clue_planted: the mirror keeps other faces too

episodes.title: Maa Ka Raaz
episodes.beat: Maa baat karti hai. Bees saal pehle usne bhi ek raat sheesha dekha tha - nahi, nahi dekha, sirf palatne se pehle dekh liya tha usne. Tab se dhakka usi par hai.
episodes.caption_dev: माँ ने भी एक बार देखा था।
episodes.cliffhanger: Maa kehti hai maine naaleek band rakha tha, par ek raat main khud ne dhakka hata diya tha.
episodes.clue_planted: Maa also owes the mirror

episodes.title: Babulal Ka Note
episodes.beat: Padosi Babulal se milne nahi jaata. Darwaze pe unka likha hua note milta hai - teen bate, tees raatein, aur ek teesri baat jo padhne layak nahi.
episodes.caption_dev: बाबूलाल ने तीन बातें लिखीं।
episodes.cliffhanger: Teen number teesra note thodi der se dikhta hai.
episodes.clue_planted: three keys, three nights

episodes.title: Teen Din Aage
episodes.beat: Count samajh aata hai: copy hamesha tees din aage hai. Aaj ki raat uska matlab tees din pehle wali raat hai.
episodes.caption_dev: वो हमेशा तीन दिन आगे है।
episodes.cliffhanger: Teen din pehle usne raat ko sheesha dekha hi nahi tha.
episodes.clue_planted: copy runs three nights ahead

episodes.title: Cheekh
episodes.beat: Pehli baar sheesha bolta hai. Awaaz maa ki hai, lekin taal alag - thoda peeche, jaise doosre kamre se aa rahi ho.
episodes.caption_dev: आईने ने माँ की आवाज़ में बात की।
episodes.cliffhanger: Wo kehti hai - beta, darwaza kholo.
episodes.clue_planted: the copy learns voices

episodes.title: Doosri Raat
episodes.beat: Narrator faisla leta hai - rule todna hai, jaanbujh kar dekhna hai. Maa rok leti hai. Raat ko dhakka khud apne haath se gir jaata hai.
episodes.caption_dev: माँ ने रोक लिया। पर धक्का गिर गया।
episodes.clue_planted: first deliberate look

episodes.title: Bahar Wala
episodes.beat: Pehli baar wo kamre ke bahar nahi, darwaze par khada hai. Chehra nahi hai - sirf ek andaaz, jo room ki roshni se bada hai.
episodes.caption_dev: वो दरवाज़े पर खड़ा था। चेहरा नहीं था।
episodes.cliffhanger: Ghar ka rasta peechhe se badal chuka hai - woh ab bahar nikalta hai.
episodes.clue_planted: it can now stand outside the mirror

episodes.title: Bhaag
episodes.beat: Bhaagne lagta hai. Sheeshe se bhaagta hai - aur ghar roz lamba hota jaata hai. Sadiyan gir jaati hain.
episodes.caption_dev: घर रोज़ लंबा हो रहा था।
episodes.cliffhanger: Bhaagne me kamra kam ho jaata hai, par darwaza dur ho jaata hai.
episodes.clue_planted: the house now assists it

episodes.title: Nana
episodes.beat: Nana ki cassette dobara chalti hai. Is baar awaaz saaf hai - wo kehte hain ek baar dekha jaye, par sirf tab jab doosra taraf dekh raha ho.
episodes.caption_dev: नाना की कैसेट फिर चली।
episodes.clue_planted: the reversal condition

episodes.title: Sheesha Band
episodes.beat: Naa leek se sheeshe ko band karta hai. Woh ek raat nikal jaata hai - par door ke bahar chhoot pakdi rehti hai.
episodes.caption_dev: शीशा बंद। पर दरवाज़ा खुला रहा।
episodes.clue_planted: covering works for one night only

episodes.title: Ek Raat Kam
episodes.beat: Hisaab lagata hai: itni raatein khatam, aur kitni bachi. Number galat hai - ek raat zyada kharch ho gayi thi.
episodes.caption_dev: एक रात ज़्यादा खर्च हो गई थी।
episodes.clue_planted: no nights left to waste

episodes.title: Ulti Taraah
episodes.beat: Naa ka formula apna leta hai: is baar wo pehle dekhega, aur doosra nahi. Aankh milane se pehle maa peeche se aa jaati hai.
episodes.caption_dev: इस बार उसने पहले देखा।
episodes.clue_planted: he takes the copy's details instead

episodes.title: Badlaav
episodes.beat: Sheeshe me chehra badalta hai - nahi, bahar ka chehra badalta hai. Jaise koi maske ki jagah badal raha ho.
episodes.caption_dev: चेहरा बाहर बदल रहा था।
episodes.clue_planted: the swap is underway

episodes.title: Pehchan
episodes.beat: Wapas aata hai - par maa pehchan nahi paati. Wo seedha ghoor ke hoti hai. Ek pal meheri hoti hai, phir haar jaati hai.
episodes.caption_dev: माँ ने एक बार भी नहीं देखा।
episodes.clue_planted: he is the copy now

episodes.title: Woh Jo Andar
episodes.beat: Andar wala narrator jo bahar wala ban chuka tha, ab doosri taraf se khatlikta hai. Uska chehra asli hai, awaaz maa wali.
episodes.caption_dev: अंदर वो अब भी बोल रहा था।
episodes.clue_planted: the original is still alive inside

episodes.title: Sheesha
episodes.beat: Teen raatein, ek teesri baat. Sheeshe ko band karta hai - is baar khud ko bahar rakh kar. Aakhri nazar me reflection kuch aur dekhta hai.
episodes.caption_dev: तीसरी बात — पीछे मत देखना।
episodes.clue_planted: next season hook
